User Request: Analyze monthly sales trends. If one chart fails to render, preserve the valid query results and explain which visualization could not be produced.

Dashboard Components:
Title: Monthly Revenue
Type: chart
Description: Monthly revenue trend
Title: Monthly Order Count
Type: chart
Description: Number of orders placed each month
Title: Top Selling Products
Type: chart
Description: Products with the highest sales volume each month
Title: Sales by Region
Type: chart
Description: Sales distribution across different regions each month
Title: Customer Segmentation by Sales
Type: chart
Description: Sales performance by customer demographics each month

sql_queries.title: Monthly Revenue
sql_queries.sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', OrderDate) AS Month, SUM(od.UnitPrice * od.Quantity * (1 - od.Discount)) AS Revenue FROM Orders o JOIN "Order Details" od ON o.OrderID = od.OrderID GROUP BY Month ORDER BY Month

sql_queries.title: Monthly Order Count
sql_queries.description: Number of orders placed each month
sql_queries.sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', OrderDate) AS Month, COUNT(OrderID) AS OrderCount FROM Orders GROUP BY Month ORDER BY Month

sql_queries.title: Top Selling Products
sql_queries.description: Products with the highest sales volume each month
sql_queries.sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', o.OrderDate) AS Month, p.ProductName, SUM(od.Quantity) AS TotalQuantity FROM Orders o JOIN "Order Details" od ON o.OrderID = od.OrderID JOIN Products p ON od.ProductID = p.ProductID GROUP BY Month, p.ProductID ORDER BY Month, TotalQuantity DESC

sql_queries.title: Sales by Region
sql_queries.description: Sales distribution across different regions each month
sql_queries.sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', o.OrderDate) AS Month, o.ShipRegion, SUM(od.UnitPrice * od.Quantity * (1 - od.Discount)) AS Revenue FROM Orders o JOIN "Order Details" od ON o.OrderID = od.OrderID GROUP BY Month, o.ShipRegion ORDER BY Month, Revenue DESC

sql_queries.title: Customer Segmentation by Sales
sql_queries.description: Sales performance by customer demographics each month
sql_queries.sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', o.OrderDate) AS Month, cd.CustomerDesc, SUM(od.UnitPrice * od.Quantity * (1 - od.Discount)) AS Revenue FROM Orders o JOIN "Order Details" od ON o.OrderID = od.OrderID JOIN CustomerCustomerDemo ccd ON o.CustomerID = ccd.CustomerID JOIN CustomerDemographics cd ON ccd.CustomerTypeID = cd.CustomerTypeID GROUP BY Month, cd.CustomerTypeID ORDER BY Month, Revenue DESC
